buildCommand: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cat paul-acts-atlas/part-*.txt | base64 -d > /tmp/paul-site.zip && unzip -q /tmp/paul-site.zip -d public && cp paul-acts-atlas/simple-v7.css public/simple-v7.css && cp paul-acts-atlas/simple-v7.js public/simple-v7.js && sed -i 's#</head>#<link rel="stylesheet" href="/simple-v7.css"></head>#' public/index.html && sed -i 's#</body>#<script src="/simple-v7.js"></script></body>#' public/index.html
